answers.core: If the core engine can be easily instructed to not look up the DLL inside the data directory, and instead look for the DLL in the same directory as the executable, adding this feature shouldn't be too hard or time-consuming. Of course, this is just a very small improvement that isn't so important, but it will make the export look better.
answers.workaround: Not without compiling a custom build of the engine.

title: When exporting C# project with NativeAOT, place the single resulting DLL alongside the executable and remove the data directory
